_about: Living registry of everything the founder has asked for. Each entry has checks the preflight runner proves automatically. 'manual' checks are studied by the /preflight review. ADD AN ENTRY WHENEVER A NEW REQUIREMENT IS GIVEN. Check types: present {file, pattern}, absent {pattern, paths, exclude}, min-count {pattern, files, min}, file-exists {file}, test {file}, manual {how}. severity: block (default) | warn.

requirements.title: Patient scores use the full range 0 to 90 (was 20 to 79); full A-E grades
requirements.source: 6 Nov: 'if skin is really good up to 90, really bad even 0'

requirements.title: Scans 1-3 show at most 80; then rises 2 per scan; 85 ceiling until a clinic visit, 90 after
requirements.source: 6-7 Nov: 'first few scans should not cross 80', 'post scan 3 gradual', 'keep cap till 85, above 85 unlocks after clinic treatment'

requirements.title: Every new scan is stamped with its scan number and clinic-visit flag before any report is built; the staff visit toggle updates all of a patient's scans
requirements.source: 7 Nov: implementation of the early-scan cap

requirements.title: One source for every score: the real scans row. The Score tab must not read the frozen skin_scans copy
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'use one source for every screen' (Score tab 85 vs report 82)

checks.how: Search for any other reader of skin_scans.analysisResults that feeds a patient-facing score; every one must be replaced by the matching scans row.

requirements.title: Weekly/monthly insights and cron reports must not apply the display curve a second time to already-calibrated scores (they would disagree with the Score tab)
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'same scores differ between screens'; found by the first deep review

checks.how: src/lib/dummyScanSummary.ts calls patientDisplayClarity() on metrics: confirm those are raw model values at scan time, not resolver output.

requirements.title: A real change is 3 points or more; 1-2 points is steady. Same rule in engine, report prompt, chat prompt
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'i feel 2 points is not a change'

requirements.title: Annotation confidence floors stay at the models' own 0.15; at most 10 circles per image; cross-photo gate hides a photo far busier than the others; staff can hide a wrong annotation
requirements.source: 4-6 Nov: fake annotations, moles must stay, 'make sure on 1 image the annotations are not abnormally high'

checks.how: After deploy, take a scan: moles must be marked and no photo may show more than 10 circles.

requirements.title: No patient-facing text is ever copied from a reference or library source
requirements.source: 4-7 Nov: 'kAI insight from textbook evidence ... de Barsy syndrome' on a patient card

requirements.title: All narrative text: AI writes, a second AI checks, code checks; any failure rewrites everything; after the limit nothing is shown (no canned fallback)
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'every text from AI ... 2 AI layers and a code layer ... if any rule is violated it goes back and does everything again'

checks.how: Remaining AI-text surfaces that still use code-written fallbacks (weekly tracker hook/causes, daily nudges, default headlines, chat). Confirm each is either covered by runVerified or listed to the founder as not yet covered.

requirements.title: Score screen cards contain only AI-written, verified text; hidden when none
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'I don't want any text to come from code'

requirements.title: 'Likely factors' cards come only from the AI; the AI is given weather, check-in, treatments and history patterns as data
requirements.source: 7 Nov

requirements.title: Every AI prompt carries the same kAI voice and safety rules (once per prompt, never duplicated)
requirements.source: 5 Nov: shared voice/safety block; reviewer: 'if pasted inline as well as appended, replace both copies'

checks.pattern: A CALM FRIEND WHO KNOWS SKINCARE

requirements.title: A drop is never called 'declined' / 'trending down' to a patient; say what it means for the skin; chips are Dipped / Steady / Too early to tell
requirements.source: 6-7 Nov reviewer feedback ('declined reads as acne getting better')

requirements.title: 'last week' only when the previous scan was within about a week; otherwise the real gap; legend says 'Last scan'
requirements.source: 6 Nov feedback (compared to 'Last week' when previous scan was 26 days earlier)

requirements.title: No AI sentence ends mid-way; no rare illness named; code rejects such drafts
requirements.source: 5-7 Nov

requirements.title: kAI chat answers small talk and general questions naturally (not only skin) while keeping every safety rule
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'How are you doing' got a generic skin answer

checks.pattern: say kindly that you are here for their skin

requirements.title: Onboarding: scan first; after the scan ASK about the questionnaire; never force it
requirements.source: 6 Nov

requirements.title: Progress and Consistency rings unlock when Scan History has 2 or more scans
requirements.source: 7 Nov: ring said 'Unlock after 2nd scan' with 4 scans

checks.how: Confirm the phone app (mobile/) has the same unlock rule, or tell the founder it does not.

requirements.title: No emojis in patient-facing UI (founder preference: looks cheap)
requirements.source: memory: feedback-no-emojis

requirements.title: Nothing the ml-worker loads may import web-only (server-only) modules, or the worker crashes at start-up and scans go offline
requirements.source: 5 Nov outage

requirements.title: Accuracy over cost: writer and checker default to a full-size model, overridable by env
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'I care less about cost but more about accuracy'

requirements.title: No API key written in source (move to server environment and rotate)
requirements.source: 6 Nov: Roboflow key found in spot_v18.py

requirements.title: Earlier agreed behaviours: kAI books clinic visits, falls back to Clinic Support when no slots; tabs named Scan / Score / Update / Chat; message box hint is 'Type a message'
requirements.source: late Oct - 3 Nov

checks.how: Open the patient app and confirm the four tab names and the 'Type a message' hint still exist; confirm booking falls back to Clinic Support when there are no slots.

requirements.title: Report content (numbers, movement labels, AI wording) compares the latest scan with the LAST scan only, never further back
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'numbers compared to last scan only, keep everything like previous'

requirements.title: The before/after slider has a small toggle: Last scan vs latest, or First scan vs latest (default Last scan). No unfounded 'passed quality checks' caption
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'for the slider show first and latest ... or a toggle between last vs latest and first vs latest'

requirements.title: No page and no scan ever waits for the AI: saved content is shown at once (even if slightly out of date) and fresh content is built in the background. A scan is marked ready without waiting for its report
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'the app became too slow even to load one previous report'

checks.how: Time a cold open of an old report and of a Score concern page on the deployed server: both must render in about a second without any AI wait.

requirements.title: Reports are informative but short (summary 60-80 words, area notes 1-2 sentences, action details 2-3 sentences) and the AI time limits fit the full-size model so reports are not left without AI text
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'the report is giving very less info ... weak if we claim insights'; screenshot showed 'AI summary unavailable'

checks.how: After deploy, read the server log for lines starting '[verified:' - the update and first-scan reports must pass within 1-2 attempts. If every attempt is rejected, read the rejection reasons and tune the prompt or the checker rules.

requirements.title: AI report text is warm and human and does not repeat figures already on the screen: digits only in the summary (max two, from the data) and in action details; headline, findings, factors, recap and next step use words only
requirements.source: 7 Nov: 'the AI section should have warmth and should not repeat the numbers or data already visible somewhere else in the report'

checks.pattern: It repeats what the patient can already see
write NO digits or numbers at all

checks.how: Read three real AI reports after deploy (first scan, a dip, a steady one): warm, human, no numbers, nothing the screen already shows. The weekly tracker text (src/lib/ragPatientTrackerReport.ts) still quotes scores; confirm with the founder whether it should follow the same rule.

requirements.title: Patient screens never use 'baseline' or 'parameter' (say 'starting point' / 'skin area'); report cards are AI-written
requirements.source: Open items #2: technical wording on the report screen; decided: the AI writes those cards

requirements.title: Both report prompts receive the patient's first name, skin type, main concern and main goal, and are told to open with the name, mention skin type once and start from their concern (skip any that is missing, never guess)
requirements.source: Open items #3 / Prompt inputs rows 1-3

checks.how: After deploy, run the query that counts how many patients have primary_concern vs primary_goal filled, to confirm the right field(s) are used.

requirements.title: The note under each skin area is written by the AI (focus area plus biggest movers, at most three); areas without an AI note show no note, never a fixed sentence
requirements.source: Open items #4 and 'no text from code'

checks.how: Open a new report: three areas show a warm AI note when selected; the other three show none. Check the PDF export for the same.

requirements.title: Report next step is exactly 'Message your doctor about ...' or 'Book an in-person visit' (type book_medixora); a doctor is never named in report text, PDF footer or defaults
requirements.source: Open items #5 and #15

checks.how: Check where the report screen uses the next-step 'type': book_medixora must still open the visit-booking action, and message_doctor the doctor chat.

requirements.title: 'Your week': boxes are the patient's real check-in figures (dash when none); the line under them is AI-written (a light optional invitation when there is no check-in); no fixed sentence from code
requirements.source: Open items #6

checks.how: Open a report for a patient with no weekly check-in: four dashes and one gentle invitation line (or no line while the AI is still writing). Decide whether four dashes look right or the boxes should hide.

requirements.title: A move of 3-4 points is described as 'a little' better or softer, in chat, report and Score notes
requirements.source: Open items #7

checks.pattern: Size of a move, in words

requirements.title: The weekly check-in is never described with a wrong number of questions (the app asks 7 over 2 screens, so the chat says 'a few quick questions')
requirements.source: Open items #8

requirements.title: Chat and reports share one calm-friend voice (no filler openers); the report guardrails include the same voice lines as the chat
requirements.source: Open items #9

requirements.title: Reports are always in English; the chat answers in English, Hindi or Hinglish (matching the patient)
requirements.source: Open items #14: 'Keep report in English and chat in all 3 languages'

requirements.title: Photo quality (live lighting/framing at capture) and what is on the face (beard, glasses, makeup, one optional tap) are saved with each scan and sent to both report prompts
requirements.source: Prompt inputs rows 10-11: 'occlusion flags' and 'capture quality metrics' were not actually sent

checks.how: Take a scan on the web: tap Beard on the final screen, finish, and confirm the saved scan has scores.captureMeta (occlusions + one entry per photo). Phone-app scans (mobile/) do not send it yet; old scans have none.

requirements.title: Both report prompts follow the reviewer's reworked document (9 Nov): calm-friend voice, plain-words list, skin type, routine steps, no ingredients/products, Indian skin notes, generic in-clinic line, optional check-in; numbers only in the summary (max two) and action details; a real change starts at 3 points
requirements.source: kAI-Prompts-final.docx (9 Nov 2026) + founder decisions (numbers as in the prompt; 3-point rule and richer findings kept)

checks.pattern: never the word "pigmentation" in the text
A move of 1 or 2 points is normal scan-to-scan variation
more than two numbers in summary

checks.how: Item 16 (on hold): run the made-up-patient test script to confirm real AI output passes the code checker (summary 60-80 words, headline under 12 words, at most 2 numbers in the summary).
